Two Harbours (invented for DMbot's tests; every name here is made up)

Frostmere is a frozen town on a grey northern bay. Its fishers mend their nets by lamplight.

Sunreach is a sweltering port far to the south, where the market opens before dawn to beat the sun.

Four travellers sail between the two: Cerric Vanya'elen, Belleros Stormgrace, Okthandom Korran and Claude Ambere.
